# Lays out the Beit Midrash shelf (2026-11-08). The GUI cannot measure the
# books it lists, so this fills each genre's shelves here: books in band order

# of the highest standing in the viewer's rite. The stand is shown for
# Machshavah, which has no foundational work, and for Talmudics when the viewer's
# rite does not hold the Bavli canonical (a Karaite library).

# kehillah_lib_stand_<genre> (the stand's work, when there is one).

	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_90 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_90 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_90 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_90 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_91 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_91 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_91 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_91 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_91 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_91 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_92 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_92 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_92 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_92 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_92 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_92 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_93 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_93 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_93 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_93 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_93 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_93 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_94 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_94 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_94 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_94 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_94 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_94 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_95 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_95 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_95 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_95 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_95 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_95 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_96 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_96 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_96 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_96 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_96 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_96 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_97 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_97 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_97 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_97 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_97 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_97 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_98 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_98 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_98 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_98 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_98 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_98 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_99 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_99 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_99 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_99 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_99 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_99 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 1 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 1 F = work_authored_100 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 2 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 2 F = work_authored_100 } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_lib_genre_work_authored_100 = 3 } kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = { G = 3 F = work_authored_100 } }

	if = { limit = { exists = var:kehillah_lib_rows_1 } remove_variable = kehillah_lib_rows_1 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_1 value = var:kehillah_lib_rowc_1 }
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_lib_acc_1 = 0 } set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_1 value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = var:kehillah_lib_rows_2 } remove_variable = kehillah_lib_rows_2 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_2 value = var:kehillah_lib_rowc_2 }
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_lib_acc_2 = 0 } set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_2 value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { exists = var:kehillah_lib_rows_3 } remove_variable = kehillah_lib_rows_3 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_3 value = var:kehillah_lib_rowc_3 }
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_lib_acc_3 = 0 } set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rows_3 value = 0 } }
}

# Parameters G (genre) and F (work flag): the held work of the highest
# standing so far takes the genre's reading stand.
kehillah_lib_shelf_stand_try_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:library ?= { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:$F$ } }
			kehillah_lib_standing_$F$ > var:kehillah_lib_best_$G$
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_best_$G$ value = kehillah_lib_standing_$F$ }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_stand_$G$ value = flag:$F$ }
	}
}

# Parameters G and F: put a held book on the next shelf with room (452 px).
kehillah_lib_shelf_place_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:library ?= { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:$F$ } }
			NOT = { var:kehillah_lib_stand_$G$ ?= flag:$F$ }
		}
		change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_acc_$G$ add = kehillah_lib_spine_width_$F$ }
		if = {
			limit = { var:kehillah_lib_acc_$G$ > 452 }
			change_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_rowc_$G$ add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_acc_$G$ value = kehillah_lib_spine_width_$F$ }
		}
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_row_$F$ value = var:kehillah_lib_rowc_$G$ }
	}
}
